description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: updates an existing booking (reschedule, rename, mark cancelled/no-show). YCBM API: PATCH /v1/bookings/{bookingId} (JSON, partial update). Set any of title/startsAt/endsAt/cancelled/noShow/timeZone/locale/units; use the `fields` passthrough for answers/linkFields or other documented fields. The path id is never sent in the body.

bookingId.description: The booking id to update (path only; required).

cancelled.description: Set true to cancel the booking, false to un-cancel.

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

noShow.description: Mark the attendee as a no-show (true) or not (false).

name: update_booking
title: Update a booking
